007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Task;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013
014import java.util.Locale;
015
016/** Sample for updating one DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT task attribute. */
017public final class SetTaskAttributeSample {
018
019    private SetTaskAttributeSample() {
020    }
021
022    /**
023     * Runs the sample using the configured database task and selected attribute overload.
024     *
025     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
026     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails; the process exits unsuccessfully
027     */
028    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
029        String taskName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TASK_NAME");
030        String attributeName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_ATTRIBUTE_NAME");
031        String attributeValue = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE");
032        String attributeType = envOrDefault("SELECTAI_AGENT_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE", "string")
033                .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
034
035        try (SelectAIAgent selectAIAgent = createClient()) {
036            Task task = selectAIAgent.task(taskName);
037            boolean updated = switch (attributeType) {
038                case "string" -> task.setAttribute(attributeName, attributeValue);
039                case "boolean" -> task.setAttribute(attributeName, parseBoolean(attributeValue));
040                case "integer" -> task.setAttribute(attributeName, Integer.valueOf(attributeValue));
041                case "float" -> task.setAttribute(attributeName, Float.valueOf(attributeValue));
042                default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException(
043                        "Unsupported task attribute type: " + attributeType);
044            };
045            System.out.printf("Set attribute '%s' on task '%s' completed: %s%n",
046                    attributeName, taskName, updated);
047        }
048    }
049
050    private static SelectAIAgent createClient() throws SelectAIException {
051        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
052                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
053                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
054                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
055                .build());
056    }
057
058    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
059        String value = System.getenv(name);
060        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
061            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
062        }
063        return value;
064    }
065
066    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
067        String value = System.getenv(name);
068        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
069    }
070
071    private static boolean parseBoolean(String value) {
072        if ("true".equalsIgnoreCase(value)) {
073            return true;
074        }
075        if ("false".equalsIgnoreCase(value)) {
076            return false;
077        }
078        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Boolean attribute value must be true or false");
079    }
080}
